name: D.G. Vaishnav College
officialName: Dwaraka Doss Goverdhan Doss Vaishnav College (Autonomous)
summary: D.G. Vaishnav College is a linguistic minority institution established in 1964 by the Rajasthani and Gujarati communities settled in Chennai. An autonomous college on E.V.R. Periyar High Road, Arumbakkam, it runs a government-aided day shift (Shift I) and a large self-financing evening shift (Shift II) with over 30 undergraduate programmes.
